critical_flows: Navigate to the next page using the 'Next' button.
Click on a tag link to filter quotes by that tag.
Verify quote and author display within quote container.
validations: Verify 'Next' button redirects to the correct page.
Verify tag link filters quotes and displays the tag name in the URL/page title.
Verify that author name displayed within the quote container matches the actual author of the quote.
test_focus: Pagination: Ensure correct navigation and data display across multiple pages.
Tag Filtering: Correct filtering and display of quotes based on selected tags.
Data Integrity: Correctness and consistency of quote and author information.
risks: Pagination issues: Incorrect page navigation, missing or duplicate data.
Tag link errors: Incorrect filtering, broken links, or security vulnerabilities related to URL manipulation.
XSS vulnerability: Potential for malicious code injection through quote text or author names, especially if user-generated content is involved.
